analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction that an address change made in branch was never processed, statements went to her old address and were opened by new owners, creating a data privacy concern and material inconvenience (CH-1).
analysis.summary: Customer [PERSON_1] changed her address in branch on 12/08/2026, but the request was never processed and statements kept going to her old address. The new owners opened one and phoned her. This is her third call about it. She is worried about who has seen her details. The address has now been corrected and a data incident form (DI-0931) raised. She wants it fixed and reassurance.

timeline.event: Customer made address change request in branch; it was never processed.
Statements continued to be sent to old address; new owners opened one and called the customer.
Customer rang the bank about the issue on two earlier occasions.
Customer rang for the third time; complaint received by phone. Address updated and data incident form raised.

analysis.severity_reason: Customer has contacted the bank three times about the same issue (CH-6 Medium). No financial loss stated. Possible data exposure may be handled via the data incident process, but no systemic issue or fraud is evidenced.

vulnerability.suggested_support: No indicators recorded by the handler. Consider sensitively asking whether she needs any support given her worry about her data being exposed.

analysis.routing_reason: No ESC-1 trigger is evident: no fraud or unauthorised transaction reported, no lending issue, no vulnerability referral criteria, no systemic issue, legal threat or media contact, and no technical fault. The handler can resolve it. The data incident is already raised through its own process.

policy_citations.quote: repeated service failure (the customer has contacted us three or more times about the same issue)
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Customer has rung three times about the same unprocessed address change, so severity is Medium.

policy_citations.quote: A complaint is any expression of dissatisfaction, oral or written, about the bank's products, services or staff
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Customer is dissatisfied with the failure to process her address change and worried about her data, so this is a complaint.

policy_citations.quote: Handlers must look for indicators of vulnerability in everything the customer says or writes
policy_citations.how_it_applies: No indicators were found; the customer's worry about her data was considered but does not itself indicate a driver.

evidence.quote: Address change request in branch 12/08 never processed.
This is the third time she's rung about it.
statements are still going to her old address

handover.complaint_summary: Address change requested in branch on 12/08/2026 was never processed. Statements went to the old address and the new owners opened one and called the customer. Third contact about it. Customer is worried about who has seen her details.
handover.products_and_accounts: MISSING (account reference not given; account type inferred as current account from statements)
actions_taken: Address updated to correct address on 2026-10-18
handover.vulnerability_assessment: No vulnerability indicators recorded by the handler. Not stated whether the customer was asked about support needs.
open_questions: What was in the statement opened by the new owners, and how many statements went to the old address?
Why was the 12/08 branch request not processed?
What were the dates of the two earlier calls and what was done each time?
Has the customer been given an update on the data incident outcome?
Should the customer be offered support or reassurance on possible exposure of her details?

other_gaps: Details and dates of the two previous calls not recorded
Content of the opened statement unknown
Whether the old-address mailing has been stopped is not recorded
analysis.suggested_next_step: Handler to log and acknowledge in writing within 3 business days (CH-2), confirm with the data incident team what exposure occurred, check statements are now going to the right address, and give the customer a plain update. A person decides outcome and any redress.
